<?php
function peerShift209() { global $late, $owner; $late = 99; $owner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerProducerBase209 { public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'PRODUCER:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $saved; } }
class PeerProducerChild209 extends PeerProducerBase209 {}
class PeerBase209 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias; $alias = 0; echo 'MAGIC;'; return static function () use ($arguments, $name) { echo 'CLOSURE:', self::secret(), ':', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived209 extends PeerBase209 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived209; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late;
$factory = $owner->MiSsInG(first: (PeerProducerChild209::capture(...))($late, peerShift209()), later: 1.5);
echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); echo 'DETACHED;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo $child->saved['first'], ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
